text:
Nora (CS): Heads-up — Hearthwell Medical flagged multiple feature requests during their onboarding review. Main themes: patient deduping sensitivity, ability to pin authoritative record, and an admin toggle for search freshness. They called it out as blocking full production roll; renewal check-in next Tues.
Diego (PM): Thanks Nora. Can you paste the raw snippets they sent (short quotes) and a sense of impact (blocker / mitigatable)?
Nora (CS): Quotes they provided: 
- "Search keeps collapsing different clinic entries into one. We lost a new referral."
- "Ops can't force the more recent record to be top."
Impact: blocking (can't trust data), customer will not complete prod cutover until fixed.
Amelie (Solutions): Re: admin toggle — we already have `cache_ttl` and per-tenant rerank in limited form, but no UI to pin records. We should log this as a product ask: 'per-tenant pin & freshness controls + audit trail'. High-priority for onboarding customers.
Ravi (Eng): Quick note: the dedupe pipeline runs post-rerank and uses a learned embedding threshold + heuristics. We could surface a per-tenant flag to lower dedupe aggression, but pinning requires a small feature (pin_id on tenant config + skip-dedupe list). Low-risk but needs schema work.
Nora (CS): They also asked about how we communicate model upgrades — Hearthwell said last update changed behavior without notice. They want notification or a release rollback option.
Diego (PM): Good signal. Let's capture three deliverables: (1) short-term: per-tenant dedupe threshold toggle; (2) medium: admin pin/override UI + audit log; (3) long-term: release notification + per-tenant model pinning. I'll create an epic.
Jared (CS Lead): Label this renewal-risk. Add to the renewal playbook and assign a CS owner to summarize before the call. Nora to own.
Nora (CS): Will do. Renewal call scheduled 2025-07-08 10:00 PDT. I'll send Hearthwell the mitigation suggestion (lower threshold) and ask if they'd accept an interim config change.
Amelie (Solutions): To prioritize, recommend we add a column in the CS feedback tracker: impact = "onboarding-blocker" and add a field 'client-accepts-temp-change'.
cs-bot: Created ticket CS-4917 and added row F-2025-072 to the Customer Feedback tracker: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs-feedback. Linked to GH issue #6120.
Ravi (Eng): I'll scope the schema change for pin/skip list. Quick ETA: 3 dev days + 1 QA day. For the toggle I can push a runtime flag in one day.
Diego (PM): Schedule a 90-min triage with eng + solutions tomorrow. We need: acceptance criteria, rollback plan, and message draft for the customer.
Amelie (Solutions): I'll draft the customer note explaining the upgrade impact and the short-term option. Quick draft snippet for Nora to send: 
```
Hi Sarah, thanks for the call. We're rolling a temporary search dedupe relaxation for your tenant to ensure recent records surface first. This is reversible and logged — we'll follow up with a permanent control in Q3.
```
Nora (CS): Perfect. I'll add that to the ticket and ping Hearthwell.
Diego (PM): I'll create the PM epic and add links to CS-4917, GH-6120, and the feedback row. Will post the triage invite here.
Nora (CS): Thanks all — will update thread after the triage. :thumbsup:
